_README: Written by scripts/write_constants.py. Sources and verbatim quotes in data/lit/constants/CONSTANTS_SOURCES.md.

ago2_copies_per_cell.what_is_counted: Argonaute proteins available to be loaded with a transfected guide. Ago1-4 total, because a transfected siRNA is not restricted to AGO2.

low_and_central_source.method: AQUA absolute quantification by tandem MS with heavy tryptic peptide standards
low_and_central_source.citation: Janas MM, Wang B, Harris AS, Aguiar M, Shaffer JM, Subrahmanyam YVBK, Behlke MA, Wucherpfennig KW, Gygi SP, Gagnon E, Novina CD. RNA 2012;18(11):2041-2055.
low_and_central_source.quote: we determined that there are approximately 15,000 Ago1-4 molecules per HeLa cell based on the YTPVGR peptide standard

high_source.cell_type: mouse P4 epidermis and human WM239A melanoma; NOT HeLa
high_source.method: quantitative western blot against recombinant Ago standards assuming 80% extraction efficiency; shotgun 2D-LC-MS/MS set the Ago1:Ago2:Ago3 ratios
high_source.citation: Wang D, Zhang Z, O'Loughlin E, Lee T, Houel S, O'Carroll D, Tarakhovsky A, Ahn NG, Yi R. Genes Dev 2012;26(7):693-704.
high_source.quote: the total copy number of Argonaute proteins is ~1.4 x 10^5 to 1.7 x 10^5 molecules per cell in mice and humans

erratum.quote: the authors incorrectly stated that Wang et al. (2012) found 14,000-17,000 Ago1-4 molecules per cell ... when in fact they found 140,000-170,000 molecules per cell

ago2_copies_per_cell.ago2_only_hela_derived_note: 0.4 x 15,000, using Janas' own statement that ~40% of HeLa Ago is Ago2. Derived arithmetic, not stated in the paper.
ago2_copies_per_cell.brief_said: 1.4e5 to 1.7e5 attributed to AGO2 measured by shotgun proteomics; that attribution is incorrect on both counts and the HeLa-specific value is tenfold lower

mrna_molecules_per_cell.cell_type: GM12878 lymphoblastoid; no HeLa-specific spike-in calibrated measurement was found
mrna_molecules_per_cell.method: SMART-seq with ERCC spike-in quantification standards
mrna_molecules_per_cell.citation: Marinov GK, Williams BA, McCue K, Schroth GP, Gertz J, Myers RM, Wold BJ. Genome Res 2014;24(3):496-510.
mrna_molecules_per_cell.quote: we estimate the absolute number of RNA molecules per cell for each gene and find significant variation in total mRNA content: between 50,000 and 300,000 transcripts per cell

cross_check.citation: Bosson AD, Zamudio JR, Sharp PA. Mol Cell 2014;56(3):347-359.

rejected_value.why: traces to a QIAGEN FAQ page with no citation, for 'a mammalian cell', not a measurement and not HeLa

kd_seed_match_molar.target: seed-matching target, guide positions 2-8, 7-mer seed pairing only
kd_seed_match_molar.system: mouse AGO2-RISC loaded with let-7, MEF S100 lysate, 25 C, nitrocellulose filter binding
kd_seed_match_molar.citation: Wee LM, Flores-Jasso CF, Salomon WE, Zamore PD. Cell 2012;151(5):1055-1067.
kd_seed_match_molar.quote: direct binding assays found no substantive difference in affinity between a seed-matching (KD = 26 +/- 2 pM) and a fully complementary target (20 +/- 10 pM)
caveats: KM is not KD; the paper says so explicitly
measured on a fully accessible unstructured oligo target in lysate at 25 C, not an mRNA in a cell, so using it as an absolute in-cell scale overestimates affinity
the article carries a published correction (Cell 2013;152:366) whose content could not be retrieved

kd_full_complementarity_molar.system: mouse AGO2-RISC, same assay as the seed-match value
kd_full_complementarity_molar.note: the measured affinity gain from full complementarity over seed pairing alone is small, which is why the on-target column is anchored on this measured value rather than extrapolated from a duplex free energy

kd_seed_mismatched_molar.target: target with a g4g5 seed mismatch, i.e. no functional seed match; used only to bracket the background term beta
kd_seed_mismatched_molar.system: FLY Ago2-RISC by equilibrium competition; species caveat applies, the mouse equivalent was not reported

sources: Guillaume-Gentil et al. 2016, BNID 112928, cytoplasmic median 1.6 +/- 0.7 pL
